notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three Frogs, Otters, Birds and/or Rats excluding Glarb that do not have summoning sickness.
Glarb does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate any number of Frogs, Otters, Birds, and/or Rats you control except Glarb by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{B}.
Cast Disinformation Campaign by paying {1}{U}{B}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
When Disinformation Campaign enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and each opponent to discard a card.
Activate Glarb by tapping it, causing you to surveil 2.
Disinformation Campaign's second ability triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
